title: Read a query value
summary: Laravel: Read a query value. Leave out q.
introduction: Laravel can give the route a Request object. GET /search?q=cat reads the query value.
learningObjectives: Read a query value with Laravel

blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.

blocks.title: Read a query value
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::get("/search", fn (Request $request) => response()->json(["term" => $request->query("q", "")]));

blocks.text: Laravel supplies the Request object. query reads q and finds cat.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Query inputs should be checked before important use.
